sentences.s: The most thoroughly studied intellectuals in the history of the New World are the ministers and political leaders of seventeenth-century New England.

sentences.s: According to many books and articles, New England's leaders established the basic themes and preoccupations of an unfolding, dominant Puritan tradition in American intellectual life.

sentences.zh: 新英格兰殖民地是人们追求广为人知的文明与才艺理想过程中诸多重要事件的发生场景。

sentences.zh: 他们的思维常常带有一种传统的迷信色彩。
